articles.title: Hopkins’ late stunner sends Kansas City past Gotham and into NWSL final
articles.summary: Hopkins’ 89th-minute volley seals dramatic 2-1 upset. Bethune scores stunning free kick against top seeds. Current to face Washington Spirit for first NWSL title. After a week dominated by a headline-grabbing stadium scheduling imbroglio, Gotham FC and the Kansas City Current finally got down to…
body: Haley Hopkins delivered the knockout blow at the death, hitting an 89th-minute volley off the crossbar and in to seal a 2-1 upset that left Gotham FC’s title defense in tatters. Paired with Croix Bethune’s first-half free-kick stunner, the late winner sent fourth-seeded Kansas City past the defending champions into a championship showdown in six days against the Washington Spirit.

On a windswept afternoon where unyielding gusts undercut the warmth of a cloudless 50F sky, a physical opening stretch produced six fouls in the first eight minutes before either side threatened. Gotham recorded the first shot after 12 minutes when Jaedyn Shaw ran onto a Guro Reiten pass and missed wide right. Kansas City answered three minutes later, with Malawian star Temwa Chawinga firing wide left from the center of the area.

Twenty minutes in, Bethune won a free kick 25 yards out after a foul by Denise O’Sullivan. Stepping up with her left foot, she coolly curled her strike around the Gotham wall and inches inside the post. The goal from Bethune, the NWSL’s midfielder of the year two seasons ago with Washington, left the crowd in stunned silence before a smattering of boos echoed around the ground.

articles.title: Mirra Andreeva holds nerve against Svitolina to win WTA Finals for first time
articles.summary: Andreeva seals 7-5, 6-3 victory to earn world No 2 ranking. Russian dominates tournament without losing a set. Mirra Andreeva had put herself on the brink of securing another effortless, straightforward set in one of the biggest finals of her career when she momentarily balked.
body: There have already been many times in Andreeva’s young career when similar sequences triggered epic, dramatic collapses, so prone the 19-year-old has been to losing her composure when things do not go her way. This time, she betrayed no negative emotions at all. Andreeva immediately retrieved the break and regained her momentum as she marched to a monumental victory, defeating Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 to win the WTA Finals at Indian Wells for the first time.

This is the perfect end to a year in which Andreeva won her first grand slam title at Roland Garros and established herself as one of the leading players of her generation. She will rise to a new high ranking of No 2 and she will sit just 293 points behind Elena Rybakina, who starts her 2027 season by attempting to defend the Australian Open title. Andreeva has put herself in the perfect position to attack the No 1 ranking at the beginning of the year.

articles.title: Greaves out of Grand Slam despite win over Zonneveld
articles.summary: Beau Greaves' win over Niels Zonneveld is in vain as she is knocked out of the Grand Slam of Darts because of Saturday's heavy defeat by Luke Littler.
body: Beau Greaves was eliminated from the Grand Slam of Darts at the group stage despite ending her campaign with a win over Niels Zonneveld in Wolverhampton.
Greaves, 22, beat Dutchman Zonneveld 5-3 but it was not enough to keep her in the competition after Saturday's heavy defeat by Luke Littler.
The three-time women's world champion fought back impressively from 3-1 down, winning three consecutive legs to take the lead in the best-of-five match.
She missed two match darts in a tense final leg but 28-year-old Zonneveld could not capitalise, failing to take out 154 before Greaves finished with double eight to seal the victory.

articles.title: England fend off fiery Spain fightback after Anderson’s red to top Nations League group
articles.summary: It was the game to show Thomas Tuchel where his rebooted England team had got to; surely the ultimate test in international football. Spain in Spain. A world champion team who, in Tuchel’s words, had “forgotten how to lose.” Before this Nations League group decider, they had been beaten only once…
body: What England produced for 65 minutes was extraordinary. What followed was equally so for different reasons. When it was over, England had made the most sensational of statements. Back in 2018, on their previous visit to Spain, England won 3-2 in Seville in the Nations League; it was one of Sir Gareth Southgate’s most famous results, an ignition point. It was the same scoreline and the same feeling for Tuchel on Sunday night.

England led 3-0. It was Harry Kane, of course, who put them in front from the penalty spot; the best player in the world damaging the best team. When Ezri Konsa and Ben White added the others, the travelling supporters were pinching themselves. With Jude Bellingham to the fore, England had run riot.

It was not over. Far from it. Everything changed when Jarell Quansah made a big error as the last man, robbed by Lamine Yamal, who got into the area and was fouled by Elliot Anderson. It was a red card for the England midfielder and a penalty for Spain. When Mikel Oyarzabal converted, it was the prompt for a siege.

articles.title: LSU star MiLaysia Fulwiley arrested after allegedly striking police officer with car
articles.summary: Guard allegedly tried to flee traffic stop in Baton Rouge. Tigers say they are aware of situation involving player. LSU guard MiLaysia Fulwiley, one of the ninth-ranked Tigers’ leading scorers, was arrested after allegedly striking a police officer while attempting to flee from a traffic stop.
body: LSU’s athletic department, in a written statement provided to The Associated Press, said university officials “are aware of the situation and have no further comment at this time as it’s an ongoing legal matter.”
The arrest, first reported by WBRZ TV in Baton Rouge, occurred Saturday night as LSU’s football game against Texas was ending in the sold-out, 102,000-seat Tiger Stadium.

Authorities allege that an officer tried to stop the 21-year-old Fulwiley after observing her weaving through traffic, and that she drove away from the scene, the right front side of her vehicle striking a police officer. She allegedly sought to cut through a store parking lot before her vehicle was blocked by responding police.
Fulwiley was booked into East Baton Rouge Parish Prison on charges including aggravated battery, flight from an officer, aggravated assault and resisting an officer.

articles.title: LeBron James now third in all-time NBA assists
articles.summary: LeBron James had 11 assists and moved into third on the NBA's career list, as he added 15 points and six rebounds to lead the Philadelphia 76ers past the Indiana Pacers 131-124 on Sunday.
body: James, who turns 42 next month, dished one to VJ Edgecombe in the fourth quarter for assist 12,092 to pass Jason Kidd on the career list. John Stockton and Chris Paul are No 1 and 2 in NBA history.
James continued an early habit in his first season with the Sixers in picking his spot to take control of a game.

This one came in the third quarter, right after Sixers fans went wild when seldom-used 7-foot-6 center Tacko Fall checked into the game. James immediately went to work picking apart the Pacers and scored eight straight points to give them an 82-73 lead.

Fall helped in that pivotal third quarter stretch for James. Fall grabbed an offensive rebound that led to a possession where James would sink two from the free-throw line. James then added a near-uncontested driving layup because of a perfect screen from Fall. James added a 20-footer and a dunk during the run.

articles.title: Grand Slam of Darts: Four seeds crash out as Greaves exits despite win
articles.summary: Seeds Jonny Clayton, Ross Smith, Josh Rock and Luke Woodhouse were all knocked out of the Grand Slam of Darts on Sunday, while Beau Greaves was also eliminated.
body: Fifth seed Clayton was demolished 5-1 in barely 10 minutes by former world champion Rob Cross, who posted an impressive 114 average and finishing stats of 83 per cent.
Clayton was the second seed to be eliminated on Sunday after 15th-seed Luke Woodhouse lost 5-1 to Krzysztof Ratajski.
In the final match of the afternoon session, eighth seed Josh Rock knew he could not afford to lose three legs to Kevin Doets, but he ultimately lost the match 5-3.
And in the evening session, sixth seed Smith beat Gabriel Clemens 5-4, but conceded too many legs and exits the tournament following Saturday's shock loss to Rusty-Jake Rodriguez.

articles.title: Townsend hails Scotland's defence in Australia 'arm wrestle'
articles.summary: Scotland's Nations Championship win over Australia was far from a classic, but head coach Gregor Townsend says it was one of his side's best defensive performances in recent years.
body: Scotland head coach Gregor Townsend hailed his team's defensive efforts after they edged past Australia in a Nations Championship "arm wrestle" at Murrayfield.
Off the back of being dismantled by New Zealand last weekend, in which they failed to score a second half point, the spotlight fell on Scotland's leaky defence.
But on a chilly and damp Edinburgh day where physicality was king, they delivered a much-needed win and showed they are capable of winning ugly.
Max Jorgensen's late converted try gave the Wallabies hope, and with the clock in the red, the visitors broke from their own half.

articles.title: England talking points: Tuchel learns Argentina lesson as full-backs shine
articles.summary: After England beat Spain in their own back yard in a statement result, we look at the main talking points from a memorable moment in Madrid...
body: England beat Spain 3-2 in a statement performance and result in Madrid; the Three Lions ended the world champions' 43-game unbeaten run to top their Nations League group and be a seeded team for the quarter-finals in March; Sky Sports look at the main talking points from the big result...

England's football DNA has been in focus this autumn. In Madrid, we saw the English style at its best. From the first whistle, England were boldly on the front foot, overwhelming Spain with pace, power and directness.
They snapped into tackles and gave short shrift to their opponents when they called for fouls. It was physical, it was aggressive. It was certainly not England trying to replicate the Spanish style.

The set-piece routine for the second goal was a reflection of how those phases have risen in importance in the Premier League and fittingly saw two Arsenal players combine to score it. Then, when down to 10 men, there was fight, heart and commitment to get over the line.

articles.title: Ten-man England hold on to claim famous win over Spain
articles.summary: England withstood a Spain fightback after Elliot Anderson's red card to secure a famous 3-2 victory and finish above the world champions at the top of their Nations League group.
body: Thomas Tuchel's side were sensational for an hour in Madrid, taking the lead when Harry Kane scored a penalty at the end of the first half and then adding quickfire goals from Ezri Konsa and Ben White.
But a one-sided game was turned on its head when Elliot Anderson was sent off for a last-man foul on Lamine Yamal following Jarell Quansah's error, allowing Mikel Oyarzabal to score from the spot.
Spain reduced the deficit to one goal when substitute Nico Williams converted Lamine Yamal's cross after Anthony Gordon had been dispossessed, but England clung on thanks to James Trafford.

The goalkeeper, selected ahead of Jordan Pickford, made a string of saves as Spain peppered the England goal, including a stunning double stop when he denied Fermin Lopez then somehow pushed Oyarzabal's follow-up around the post at full stretch.

articles.title: Teenager Andreeva caps stunning week with WTA Finals title
articles.summary: French Open champion Mirra Andreeva caps her stellar season with a hard-fought victory over Elina Svitolina to win the WTA Finals.
body: For Mirra Andreeva, the thought of her first WTA Finals singles campaign was so stressful that it gave her "a little breakdown" in a practice session before the tournament.
The 19-year-old may have been nervous on arrival at Indian Wells, but she leaves California as the champion, having been the standout player of the week.
The French Open winner produced a hard-fought 7-5 6-3 victory over Elina Svitolina in Sunday's final to become the youngest champion of the event in 22 years.
The Russian has now risen to second in the world rankings - and she will start the 2027 season just 293 points behind top-ranked Elena Rybakina.

articles.summary: Kyren Wilson survived a stunning late comeback from Chris Wakelin to win the Champion of Champions tournament in Leicester. Wilson, 34, looked to be cruising to victory with a 9-3 lead and needed just one more frame for victory, but a determined Wakelin fought back in the evening session to put…
body: Wakelin's impressive breaks of 131, 57 and 50 put Wilson on notice but he held his nerve for a 10-8 win with his fourth century break of the day.
The win extends Wilson's fine run of form as he sealed his third consecutive title after triumphs at the Northern Ireland Open and the International Championship.
He started confidently, taking control with a 135 break in the opening frame, and surged into a 4-0 lead before Wakelin recovered to make it 4-3.
Wilson then notched five frames in a row and had the title in his sights before Wakelin started his response to set up the thrilling finale.

articles.title: 3-Time Super Bowl Champion Rips Kyler Murray for ‘Not Being a Student of the Game’ After Vikings Trade for Kirk Cousins
articles.summary: The addition of Kirk Cousins by the Minnesota Vikings in a trade with the Las Vegas Raiders has created awkward situation for Kyler Murray. He Wasn’t able to adapt to the head coach’s style and the organization needed bring in a player who could help justin Jefferson put points on the board.
body: “Kyler Murray has a history, you know, a reported history of not being—I don’t want to call him unprofessional—but not being a student of the game. Is that fair? Yeah, I think that’s fair, right? And it’s not only widely reported, but also something sources have said behind closed doors. He’s not the most detail-oriented, hard-working quarterback when it comes to preparation in the National Football League.”

The organization looks for a player that would look at everything that goes into playing that position and all the knowledge you have to possess and give him that opportunity. Murray has not been able to maintain the momentum organization needs in a quarterback. The franchise would want a quarterback who knows the offense backward and forward and who can mentor your a young quarterback who’s taking over as the franchise quarterback.

articles.title: P.J. Fleck Fires OC Greg Harbaugh Jr. Following Minnesota's Loss To Penn State
articles.summary: Minnesota offensive coordinator Greg Harbaugh Jr. was fired Sunday with two regular-season games remaining following another rough performance by the Gophers. Coach P.J.
body: Coach P.J. Fleck announced his decision the day after the 42-14 loss at Penn State, when the Gophers converted three of 13 third downs and were scoreless for more than 38 minutes of game time until finally reaching the end zone. That was Minnesota's sixth straight game with less than 300 total yards.

"Greg has been an important part of our football program, and I want to thank him for the time, energy and commitment he gave to our players and university," Fleck said. "These decisions are never easy, but I believe this is the right one for our football team. I have tremendous respect for Greg as a coach, husband and father and thank him for his many contributions to our program. I wish him and his family the best moving forward."

Harbaugh was in his third stint on Minnesota's staff, in his fourth season as the play-caller. He was a quality control assistant in 2017 and again in 2019. After returning in 2022 as tight ends coach, Harbaugh was elevated to quarterbacks coach and co-offensive coordinator in 2023. He became the sole offensive coordinator in 2025.
